title: Token Snapshot Exportorchestrator: Batchable Token-level Attribution Cards + Pricing Presets
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design and prototype a batch-focused export UX for token-level cost attribution that produces compact "snapshot" cards for each invocation group and a set of reusable pricing presets. Goal is to let customers export NDJSON/CSV bundles with per-token breakdowns, impression-level attribution metadata, and applied pricing rule snapshots so downstream billing pipelines and auditors can replay cost calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Export UI allows selecting time-range, model route, and role-scoped filters and produces a downloadable bundle (NDJSON + manifest.json)
Each exported snapshot card includes: invocation_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, token_costs (per-token tier), applied_pricing_preset_id, model_variant, timestamp
Pricing Presets UI allows creating/saving templates (name + tier rules + rounding rules) and applying them to an export; presets are versioned and included in export manifest
Export respects SLOs: initial packaging UX responds within 3s for <=10k snapshots and provides background job link for larger exports
Design has responsive card layout for compact table view and full expanded inspection pane with token-level heatstrip visualization
Design reviewed by PM and Eng and handed off with annotated Figma frames and production spec
design_notes: 02/22: Kickoff with PM to align on data schema and required fields for auditability; agreed to include manifest.json with pricing preset snapshot.
02/25: Wireframes created for card-list, compact table, and export modal. Decided to prefer NDJSON as primary export format for streaming ingestion.

02/28: Tradeoff discussion with Eng about packaging: immediate zip-of-files vs asynchronous job with signed URL. Eng recommended async for >50k rows; design includes progressive disclosure and background job flow.

03/03: Usability test with 5 internal stakeholders (billing, SRE, security, PM, solutions) — main friction was row density in compact table; added row condensation toggle and token-heatstrip mini-view.
03/06: Security review note: exports contain token-level metadata; flagged to PM to ensure redaction controls for PII-sensitive prompts; added export filter for exclude-sensitive-tags.
03/09: Updated mockups to include pricing preset editor and on-export preview that shows estimated total cost and confidence band from sampling
comments: 2026-02-22 Aisha: Kickoff — confirmed export schema fields with Eng (ENG-50121). PM wants include pricing preset id for replayability.
2026-02-26 Marco: Initial wireframes attached; requesting sample dataset to validate NDJSON shape — PM to share anonymized dump.
2026-03-01 Priya (PM): Requested that exports include role-based ACL scoping and a pre-export permission check; blocked until ACL API is available.
2026-03-04 Security (Liam): Recommend redaction controls and explicit consent checkbox for exports that include user prompt text; added label 'sensitive-export' for follow-up.
2026-03-07 Design Review: stakeholders approved compact card concept but asked for explicit column explaining 'applied discount or rounding'. Action: add pricing delta row in manifest.
2026-03-10 Marco: Updated handoff spec in Figma and created tracking ticket ENG-50749 for background export job and signed-url delivery. Ready for engineering estimation.
Next steps: finalize ACL gating with Eng, implement export job API, run external usability test with 3 customers (billing and platform engineers).
